title: Welcome to the Gamma Files development log
body:
This is the first entry in the Gamma Files development log. Posts here will cover changelogs, development notes, decisions made along the way, and anything else worth documenting about the modpack's progress.

The modpack has been in quiet development for a while now — this site is the first public-facing home for it. Expect updates as new versions are released and as the lore and structure of the pack comes further into focus.

If you have questions or want to follow along, check the Modrinth page or the community Discord when it's up.
